title: Frappe ERPNext 15.53.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.53.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an Assets module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or users without roles, to access cost and quantity fields of purchase and stock transactions without proper record-level permission checks. The vulnerability enables reading sensitive data by sending crafted requests referencing out-of-scope records.
